subject: Linguistics
title: How Many Languages Exist
description: A fast breakdown of How Many Languages Exist for builders.

hook.text: Ask how many languages the world has and you might expect a tidy number. It's not.

buildup.text: Ethnologue currently lists about 7,000 living languages spoken around the globe.

discovery.text: The tricky part is deciding where a dialect ends and a separate language begins.

twist.text: Mandarin and Cantonese are called 'dialects' but are mutually unintelligible.

climax.text: Meanwhile Norwegian and Swedish speakers often understand each other just fine.

punchline.text: A language is a dialect with an army and a navy.

quiz.question: Roughly how many living languages does Ethnologue list?
